name: CCAvenue Gateway Integration for WooCommerce
author: malun728

sections.description:
CCAvenue Gateway Integration for WooCommerce is a lightweight and reliable WooCommerce Payment Gateway plugin that enables merchants to securely accept online payments through their CCAvenue Merchant Account.

The plugin integrates CCAvenue directly with WooCommerce and provides a seamless checkout experience for customers. Store owners can choose between Redirect Checkout and Embedded iFrame Checkout depending on their preferred payment flow.

Built specifically for WooCommerce, the plugin is easy to configure and compatible with modern WooCommerce features including WooCommerce Checkout Blocks and High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

CCAvenue is one of India’s leading payment gateways and is widely used by online stores, educational platforms, service providers, membership websites, and eCommerce businesses. This plugin helps WooCommerce merchants accept payments through payment methods supported by CCAvenue, including UPI, Credit Cards, Debit Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI Options, and more.

Built for WooCommerce Merchants

Whether you operate a local business, online store, educational platform, service website, or subscription-based business, CCAvenue Gateway Integration for WooCommerce provides a secure and reliable payment solution.

The plugin is especially useful for businesses operating in India that want to accept online payments through their existing CCAvenue merchant account while maintaining a smooth WooCommerce checkout experience.

🚀 Why Choose CCAvenue Gateway Integration for WooCommerce?

  • Accept secure online payments through CCAvenue
  • Easy WooCommerce Payment Gateway setup
  • Supports Redirect Checkout
  • Supports Embedded iFrame Checkout
  • Sandbox Mode for testing transactions before going live
  • Automatic WooCommerce order status updates
  • WooCommerce Checkout Blocks compatibility
  • HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) compatibility
  • Built-in debug logging for troubleshooting
  • Secure payment response validation
  • Simple configuration using Merchant ID, Access Code, and Working Key

⭐ Key Features

  • Adds CCAvenue as a WooCommerce payment gateway
  • Secure payment processing through your CCAvenue merchant account
  • Redirect Checkout support
  • Embedded iFrame Checkout support
  • Sandbox Mode support
  • Automatic order status synchronization
  • WooCommerce Checkout Blocks compatibility
  • HPOS compatibility support
  • Optional debug logging
  • Gateway setup checklist and guidance
  • Secure transaction validation
  • Lightweight architecture for better performance

⚙️ Easy Setup

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Navigate to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments
  3. Enable “CCAvenue Gateway”
  4. Enter your Merchant ID
  5. Enter your Access Code
  6. Enter your Working Key
  7. Select Sandbox Mode or Live Mode
  8. Save settings
  9. Start accepting payments through CCAvenue

External services

This plugin connects to the CCAvenue payment gateway to securely process payments.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active. If WooCommerce is not active, the plugin automatically deactivates itself.

What credentials do I need from CCAvenue?

You need your Merchant ID, Access Code, and Working Key from your CCAvenue merchant account.

Does the plugin support Sandbox Mode?

Yes. Sandbox Mode allows merchants to test payment transactions before enabling live payments.

Does the plugin support Redirect Checkout?

Yes. Customers can be redirected to the secure CCAvenue payment page to complete their transaction.

Does the plugin support Embedded iFrame Checkout?

Yes. Customers can complete payments using the embedded CCAvenue checkout experience.

Does the plugin support WooCommerce Checkout Blocks?

Yes. The plugin is compatible with WooCommerce Checkout Blocks.

Does the plugin support HPOS?

Yes. The plugin is compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Does the plugin support UPI payments?

The plugin uses CCAvenue’s payment infrastructure. Customers can use UPI and other payment methods enabled in your CCAvenue merchant account.

Does the plugin support credit cards, debit cards, and net banking?

Yes. Customers can use payment methods supported by your CCAvenue merchant account.

Does the plugin support multiple currencies?

Currency availability depends on your CCAvenue merchant account configuration.

Does the plugin update WooCommerce orders automatically?

Yes. Payment responses received from CCAvenue automatically update the corresponding WooCommerce order status.

Is debug logging available?

Yes. Debug logging can be enabled from the gateway settings for troubleshooting payment requests and responses.

Is customer payment information stored by the plugin?

No. Sensitive payment information is processed securely by CCAvenue and is not stored by the plugin.

Is this plugin suitable for Indian businesses?

Yes. The plugin is ideal for businesses operating in India that use CCAvenue to accept online payments through WooCommerce.

Where can I get support?

You can create a support topic on the WordPress.org plugin support forum.
